verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting continuously evaluates rules and sends notifications to external systems such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. That shows outbound alert routing exists, but the pack never shows a generic webhook contact point that could trigger automated remediation or agents. The 'take action on your alerts' wording is generic and does not establish this. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented webhook contact point, any payload/format documentation, evidence of triggering automation or agents from alerts, and independent hands-on corroboration.
